The '''Floubette system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[Southern Core]] regions.<ref name="TEA" /> The system was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Floubettean/Legends|Floubettean]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="CSWE" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> and shared its name with the [[floubette dance]].<ref name="GNN">{{JournalCite|9|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Floubette system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />
